events.title: Next Fest is live: Try the Timberline Factory demo
events.summary: Hi everyone,Steam Next Fest runs from October 19 to 26, and the Timberline Factory demo is free to play on Steam during that time. If you ever wanted to run your own sawmill, now is a good moment to give it a try.A quick word about me: I work in a real, large sawmill. That is where the idea for the game came from, and it is also where the realism comes from. events.title: Demo Update: Life in the Yard
events.summary: Thanks for keeping at it! This update brings more life to the mill.Log trucks now drive into the yard to drop off and pick up logs.Once the debarker is built, a second truck picks up debarked logs.The full game adds a new plot of land to expand onto.Small improvements to the research window and the mill walkthrough.Good luck at the mill!

events.title: The Free Demo Is Live!
events.summary: Hey everyone! The free Timberline Factory demo is now live on Steam. Saw your first logs, build conveyor lines, keep your machines running and ship your first timber order. And yes, the physics will sometimes fight back :D Early Access launches on Friday, November 6th, and you'll also find the demo at Steam Next Fest from October 19th. Feedback and bug reports are very welcome in the pinned thread in the discussions. I read everything personally! Have fun sawing! Armin

events.title: Timberline Factory is officially announced!
events.summary: Welcome to Timberline Factory!Hello everyone! I am incredibly excited to finally announce my project: Timberline Factory.This game is all about building and optimizing your own sawmill.
